svg.text: Single-tenant agent platform on Azure Container Apps · reference architecture · v1.3
Azure region · single subscription / resource group
Private Virtual Network · no agent memory or DB traffic leaves the VNet
Container Apps Environment · app-subnet (delegated) · internal ingress only
Jobs: TTL sweeper · digest poster · watchdog (self-improvement loop)
secrets read by each app at startup
Dashed component outline = optional / flag-gated service (off by default).
